newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Sales of 521,200 MT were 12 percent below the previous week and 17 percent under the 4-week average.
Major increases were reported for unknown destinations (122,500 MT), Taiwan (54,900 MT), South Korea (52,500 MT), Egypt (52,500 MT), Turkey (48,000 MT), and Lebanon (47,500 MT).
Sales activity of 46,100 MT for the 1997/98 marketing year were mainly for Japan (46,000 MT).

Exports of 423,500 MT were 58 percent below the prior week and 48 percent below the 4-week average. Japan (239,100 MT) was the leading destination, followed by Mexico (57,500 MT), Algeria (39,400 MT), Colombia (25,400 MT), and the Dominican Republic (20,500 MT).
